lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of approximately five irregular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters; a single high-intensity local maximum is located at the approximate lateral midline posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to create a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to lower-luminance shadowed regions below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-resolution high-luminance blobs primarily localized within the posterior and basal segments of the dorsal fin macro-mask.
